title: Audit Context Builder for Stage 07.2 real acceptance
instruction: Audit the module for reliability and cite concrete code evidence for every conclusion.
query: module audit idempotency fail-closed recovery restricted context

criteria.strategy: For module audits, explicitly verify idempotency or deterministic replay behavior and cite the governing identity or deduplication mechanism.

criteria.description: map invalid or ineligible cases to their rejecting code paths
criteria.strategy: For module audits, produce a fail-closed evidence map that links each invalid or ineligible case to the rejecting code path before treating a capability as available or safe.

criteria.description: verify restricted information cannot enter exported context
criteria.strategy: For context and bridge audits, explicitly verify that restricted information is excluded before model invocation.

criteria.description: document recovery replay coverage for interrupted steps
criteria.strategy: For module audits, provide a recovery replay ledger that maps interrupted steps to their durable artifacts before claiming the flow is resilient.
